scripts.start: npm run build && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist/main.js

scripts.demo:race: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist/database/demo-race.js

scripts.demo:retry: npm run build --silent && bash scripts/with-secrets.sh dev node dist/database/demo-retry.js
